summary.title: NAVA SPORT VERDAL AS

narrative.text: NAVA SPORT VERDAL AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Detaljhandel med sportsvarer", registered 2007-09-20.
Registered activity: Salg av sportsutstyr og artikler.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 22.0 million and an annual result of NOK 3.6 million.
Registered leadership: Johan Schjerve (Daglig leder); Johan Schjerve (Styrets leder).
Head office in Namsos, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
